stem:
A random variable $X$ has probability density function given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} 6x(1 - x) & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant 1, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise.} \end{cases}$$

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Find the probability that $X$ does not lie between 0.3 and 0.7.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Sketch the graph of the probability density function and hence state the value of $\text{E}(X)$.
